Name: Mebunnai the Hushathite
Summary: Mebunnai the Hushathite was among David's thirty mighty men, and slew Saph the Philistine giant at Gob. He is also called Sibbechai (rendered Sibbecai in many modern versions).
KeyStory: Mebunnai the Hushathite slew the giant Saph at Gob.
LifeLesson: The man who slew a giant is named twice — once for the deed, once for the list.
